_comment: Fighting Dojo. The Block Boss rematches.
0: Wassup!\rThe Karate King, our master, is in a cave\nin Johto, trainin' even harder.\rHe left us the Dojo. We just stand here.\nIn our gis. Sweatin'.
1: Wassup!\rWe lettin' the Block Bosses use the Dojo\nwhile the Karate King gone.\rHit 'em up once you got their numbers.\nThey'll scrap as long as they ain't busy.\fThey always busy.
4: Falkner: AYO! I been waitin' on you!\rIt's a pleasure to scrap you again!\nMy dad would be proud!\r
5: Falkner: Mmm...\nStill a long way to bein' the best...\fLike my dad...

7: Bugsy: You musta studied homies a LOT!\nMore than me? Impossible!
